#Functions for GSEA steps
```{r}
make_geneList_kegg <- function(logFC_named_by_SYMBOL) {
  # SYMBOL -> ENTREZ mapping
  ids <- suppressMessages(
    bitr(names(logFC_named_by_SYMBOL),
         fromType = "SYMBOL", toType = "ENTREZID", OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db)
  )
  
  v <- logFC_named_by_SYMBOL[ids$SYMBOL]
  names(v) <- ids$ENTREZID
  v <- v[!is.na(v) & !is.na(names(v))]
  
  # Deduplicate: Keep the entry with the highest absolute logFC for duplicate Entrez IDs
  df <- data.frame(entrez = names(v), logFC = v, absFC = abs(v), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  df <- df[order(df$absFC, decreasing = TRUE), ]
  df <- df[!duplicated(df$entrez), ]
  
  gene_list <- df$logFC
  names(gene_list) <- df$entrez
  
  # Return sorted vector
  sort(gene_list, decreasing = TRUE)
}

convert_core_enrichment <- function(entrez_string) {
  if (is.na(entrez_string) || entrez_string == "") return(NA)
  
  entrez_ids <- strsplit(entrez_string, "/")[[1]]
  
  # mapIds preserves vector order and size
  symbols <- suppressMessages(
    mapIds(org.Mm.eg.db, 
           keys = entrez_ids, 
           column = "SYMBOL", 
           keytype = "ENTREZID", 
           multiVals = "first")
  )
  
  # Fallback: keep original Entrez ID if Symbol is missing
  symbols <- ifelse(is.na(symbols), entrez_ids, symbols)
  paste(symbols, collapse = "/")
}
```

#function to create a combined_spe object
```{r}
prepare_pseudobulk <- function(spe_list, cell_types) {
  
  # Add sample identifiers
  for (nm in names(spe_list)) {
    spe <- spe_list[[nm]]
    colData(spe)$sample_id <- rep(nm, ncol(spe))
    spe_list[[nm]] <- spe
  }
  
  # Combine all samples
  combined_spe <- do.call(cbind, spe_list)
  print(table(combined_spe$sample_id, combined_spe$in_treatment))
  
  # Convert treatment to labels
  combined_spe$in_treatment <- ifelse(combined_spe$in_treatment == 1, "gfp+", "untreated")
  
  # Filter to specified cell types
  filtered_spe <- combined_spe[, combined_spe$new_cell_type %in% cell_types]
  
  # Create pseudo-bulk
  pb <- aggregateAcrossCells(filtered_spe, use.assay.type = "counts",
                             id = DataFrame(label = filtered_spe$in_treatment,
                                          sample = filtered_spe$sample_id))
  
  # Rename columns
  colnames(pb) <- paste(pb$in_treatment, pb$sample_id, sep = "_")
  
  return(pb)
}
```

#function to find DEGs
Non tiene conto della dipendenza tra treated e untreated nello stesso campione
Ma se aggiungessi semplicemente un effetto casuale per campione?
```{r}
run_de_analysis <- function(pb, fdr_threshold = 0.05, output_file = NULL) {

  y <- DGEList(counts(pb), samples = colData(pb))
  
  #Filter by expression
  keep <- filterByExpr(y, group = y$samples$in_treatment)
  y <- y[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
  
  # Normalize
  y <- calcNormFactors(y)
  
  # Set up treatment factor
  y$samples$in_treatment <- as.factor(y$samples$in_treatment)
  y$samples$in_treatment <- relevel(y$samples$in_treatment, ref = "untreated")
  
  # Design and fit
  design <- model.matrix(~ in_treatment, data = y$samples)
  y <- estimateDisp(y, design)
  fit <- glmFit(y, design)
  lrt <- glmLRT(fit, coef = "in_treatmentgfp+")
  
  # Get results
  res <- topTags(lrt, n = Inf)$table
  res$SYMBOL <- rownames(res)
  res$significant <- res$FDR < fdr_threshold
  
  # Separate significant genes
  sig <- res[res$significant, ]
  sig_up <- sig[sig$logFC >= 0, ]
  sig_down <- sig[sig$logFC < 0, ]
  
  # Summary
  gene_summary <- data.frame(
    Geni_considerati = nrow(res),
    Geni_significativi = nrow(sig),
    Upregolati = nrow(sig_up),
    Downregolati = nrow(sig_down)
  )
  
  print(gene_summary)
  
  # Export to Excel if filename provided
  if (!is.null(output_file)) {
    wb <- createWorkbook()
    addWorksheet(wb, "Tutti_geni")
    writeData(wb, "Tutti_geni", res, rowNames = TRUE)
    addWorksheet(wb, "Significativi")
    writeData(wb, "Significativi", sig, rowNames = TRUE)
    addWorksheet(wb, "Upregolati")
    writeData(wb, "Upregolati", sig_up, rowNames = TRUE)
    addWorksheet(wb, "Downregolati")
    writeData(wb, "Downregolati", sig_down, rowNames = TRUE)
    saveWorkbook(wb, output_file, overwrite = TRUE)
    cat("Results saved to:", output_file, "\n")
  }
  
  # Return results list
  return(list(
    dge = y,
    results = res,
    significant = sig,
    upregulated = sig_up,
    downregulated = sig_down,
    summary = gene_summary
  ))
}
```

#Function for DEGs and GSEA
```{r}
run_de_gsea_pipeline <- function(
  pb, 
  group_col = "in_treatment", 
  ref_level = "untreated",
  organism = "mmu",
  OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db,
  save_excel = TRUE,
  output_prefix = "gfp_vs_untreated"
) {

  pb_var_name <- deparse(substitute(pb))
  sample_suffix <- sub("^pb_?", "", pb_var_name)
  
  y <- DGEList(counts = counts(pb), samples = colData(pb))
  
  # Imposta il fattore e il livello di riferimento (untreated)
  y$samples[[group_col]] <- as.factor(y$samples[[group_col]])
  y$samples[[group_col]] <- relevel(y$samples[[group_col]], ref = ref_level)
  
  keep <- filterByExpr(y, group = y$samples[[group_col]])
  y <- y[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
  y <- calcNormFactors(y)
  
  # Usiamo ~ group_col (CON INTERCETTA) così relevel() definisce il contrasto
  design_formula <- as.formula(paste0("~ ", group_col))
  design <- model.matrix(design_formula, data = y$samples)

  y <- estimateDisp(y, design)
  fit <- glmFit(y, design)

  # 2. Test Differenziale (coef = 2 testa il secondo livello contro la reference)
  lrt <- glmLRT(fit, coef = 2)
  top <- topTags(lrt, n = Inf)$table
  top$SYMBOL <- rownames(top)
  top$significant <- top$FDR < 0.05

  # 3. Preparazione lista geni per GSEA
  geneList <- top$logFC
  names(geneList) <- top$SYMBOL
  geneList <- geneList[!is.na(geneList) & !is.na(names(geneList))]
  geneList_kegg <- make_geneList_kegg(geneList)

  # 4. GSEA
  gsea_sig <- tryCatch({
    gseKEGG(
      geneList = geneList_kegg,
      organism = organism,
      pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
      verbose = FALSE
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    warning(paste("GSEA fallita:", e$message))
    return(NULL)
  })

  # 5. Salvataggio Excel
  if (save_excel && !is.null(gsea_sig) && nrow(gsea_sig@result) > 0) {
    gsea_sig@result$core_enrichment_symbols <- sapply(
      gsea_sig@result$core_enrichment, 
      convert_core_enrichment
    )
    res_df <- as.data.frame(gsea_sig@result)
    write.xlsx(
      res_df,
      file = paste0("GSEA_", output_prefix, "_", sample_suffix, ".xlsx"),
      rowNames = FALSE
    )
  }

  # 6. Restituzione dei risultati
  return(list(
    deg = top,
    gsea = gsea_sig,
    fit = fit
  ))
}
```
